scientific_integrity: Proof establishes an exact deterministic two-moment, finite-cap interval; established lower endpoint and underlying scalar epidemic model are clearly attributed to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Not a finite-stochastic-population or peak-prevalence theorem; assumes strict interior variance, a genuine finite susceptibility cap, positive initial infection, and fixed parameters; specialized earlier applications could subsume some conclusions.
title: Sharp capped-susceptibility epidemic envelopes from two moments
